description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging at various levels, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and facilitating log node chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to facilitate logging at various levels, acting as a replacement or wrapper for Android's Log class, supporting chaining of LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message with VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message with DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message with INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message with WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message with ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message with ASSERT priority.
